review.why: Drafts contracts, proposals, SOWs and NDAs with US, EU, UK and DACH clause notes and ready templates.
review.summary: Asks for the document type, jurisdiction, engagement and parties, then fills a template: fixed-price development contract, monthly retainer, SaaS partnership and a GDPR data processing addendum, with jurisdiction notes and a pandoc conversion to docx. It states it is not legal advice.

Jurisdiction notes (work for hire, written form clauses, GDPR)
Says plainly it is not legal advice
cautions: The selector lists NDA and SOW templates that are not in the skill
